learn.hook: Your birthday is coming! How many days to wait? The calendar knows!
points: A week has 7 days. A year has 12 months.
April, June, September and November have 30 days. February has 28 days (29 in a leap year). All the other months have 31 days.
A year has 365 days. A leap year has 366 days.
The same day of the week comes again every 7 days. If 1 June is a Monday, so are 8, 15, 22 and 29 June.
To count days to a date in the next month, count to the end of this month, then add the days of the next month.

example.q: Today is 28 March. Aisha's birthday is on 5 April. How many days does she have to wait?
steps: March has 31 days. From 28 March to 31 March is 31 - 28 = 3 days.
Then 5 more days to reach 5 April.

learn.reallife: We use calendars to plan holidays, mark exams, count days to Diwali and remember birthdays.

games.title: Calendar facts
items: February gets an extra day, the 29th.
If 1 June is a Monday, then 8 June is also a Monday.
In a year that is not a leap year, February has 28 days.
Only a leap year gives February 29 days.

quiz.q: How many days are there in March?
quiz.explain: March is one of the months with 31 days.
steps: Months with 31 days: January, March, May, July, August, October, December.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up March with a 30-day month

quiz.q: In a year that is not a leap year, how many days does February have?
quiz.explain: February is the shortest month. It has 28 days, and 29 only in a leap year.
steps: In an ordinary year it has 28 days; only in a leap year does it have 29.
quiz.mistake: Gives the leap-year number of days

quiz.q: How many days are there in a year that is not a leap year?
quiz.explain: An ordinary year has 365 days. A leap year has 366.

quiz.q: 1 June is a Monday. What day is 8 June?
quiz.explain: 8 June is 7 days after 1 June. The day of the week repeats every 7 days, so it is Monday again.

quiz.q: Today is Friday. What day will it be 3 days from today?
quiz.explain: Count on: Saturday (1), Sunday (2), Monday (3).
steps: Count on from Friday, not counting today.
quiz.mistake: Counts today as one of the 3 days

quiz.q: How many weeks are there in 28 days?
quiz.explain: Each week has 7 days. 28 ÷ 7 = 4 weeks.
quiz.mistake: Takes away 7 from 28 instead of dividing

quiz.q: Today is 28 March. Aisha's birthday is on 5 April. How many days does she have to wait?
quiz.explain: 28 March to 31 March is 3 days, then 5 more days to 5 April. 3 + 5 = 8 days.

quiz.q: Which of these months has 30 days?
quiz.explain: April has 30 days. May, January and August each have 31 days.
steps: Months with 30 days: April, June, September, November.
May, January and August have 31 days.

teach.ask: Today is 25 May and Gappu's party is on 2 June. Gappu thinks it's 7 days away. How do we count?
teach.praise: Yes! May has 31 days: 25 to 31 is 6 days, then 2 more makes 8 days. Gappu is excited!
teach.nudge: How many days does May have? Count to the end of May first.

revise.summary: A week has 7 days and a year has 12 months. Months have 30 or 31 days, except February with 28 (29 in a leap year), and the same weekday comes again every 7 days.
focus: Know how many days each month has
Find the weekday a few days or weeks later
Count days to a date in the next month
remember: April, June, September and November have 30 days. February has 28 (29 in a leap year). The rest have 31
A year has 365 days; a leap year has 366
If 1 June is a Monday, so are 8, 15, 22 and 29 June
traps: Don't think March has 30 days
Don't count today as one of the days
Not every month has 30 days (12 × 30 = 360 is wrong)

learn.hook: Some children have a birthday on 29 February. They get a real birthday only once in 4 years!
points: A leap year comes every 4 years. It has 366 days because February gets a 29th day.
An ordinary year has 365 days.
2024 was a leap year. Add 4 for the next ones: 2028, 2032. Take away 4 for earlier ones: 2020, 2016.

Many festivals and special days come in fixed months: Republic Day in January, Independence Day in August, Teachers' Day in September, Gandhi Jayanti in October, Children's Day in November, Christmas in December.

example.q: 2024 is a leap year. Which are the next two leap years?

learn.reallife: Calendars help us plan holidays and festivals. Your school calendar marks Republic Day and Independence Day every year.

quiz.q: How many days are there in a leap year?
quiz.explain: A leap year has one extra day, 29 February: 365 + 1 = 366.
steps: A leap year has 1 extra day, 29 February.

quiz.q: 2024 was a leap year. Which year is the next leap year?
quiz.explain: Leap years come every 4 years: 2024 + 4 = 2028.

quiz.q: 2024 was a leap year. Which year was the leap year before it?
How often does a leap year come?
quiz.explain: One year in every 4 is a leap year.
steps: A leap year has 1 extra day, added once every 4 years.
So 1 year in every 4 is a leap year.
quiz.mistake: Thinks every other year is a leap year

quiz.q: How many days does February have in a leap year?
quiz.explain: In a leap year, February has 29 days.
steps: In an ordinary year, February has 28 days.
A leap year adds 1 day to February.

quiz.q: In which month do we celebrate Independence Day?
quiz.explain: Independence Day is on 15 August.
quiz.mistake: Mixes it up with Republic Day

quiz.q: Children's Day is on 14 November. In which month is it?
quiz.explain: 14 November is in November.
steps: The month is written after the date.

quiz.q: How many leap years are there from 2021 to 2032 (both included)?
quiz.explain: 2024, 2028 and 2032: 3 leap years.

teach.ask: Gappu was born on 29 February 2024. When will Gappu's next real birthday be? Explain.
teach.praise: 29 February comes only in leap years, every 4 years. My next real birthday is in 2028!

revise.summary: A leap year comes every 4 years and has 366 days, because February gets a 29th day. Many festivals and special days come in fixed months.
focus: Find leap years before and after a given one
Know the days in a leap year and in its February
Match special days to their months
remember: Leap year: every 4 years, 366 days, 29 February
2024 was a leap year; next 2028, 2032; earlier 2020, 2016
Republic Day: January. Independence Day: August. Teachers' Day: September. Gandhi Jayanti: October. Children's Day: November. Christmas: December
traps: Don't add 1 instead of 4
Every other year is not a leap year
Don't mix up Independence Day and Republic Day

learn.hook: If today is Wednesday, what was the day before yesterday? And what will be the day after tomorrow?
points: Yesterday is 1 day before today. The day before yesterday is 2 days before.
Tomorrow is 1 day after today. The day after tomorrow is 2 days after.
The same date moves to a later weekday in the next month. A 31-day month moves it 3 days on; a 30-day month 2 days; a 28-day February 0 days.
Example: 1 January is a Monday. January has 31 days, so 1 February is 3 days later in the week: Thursday.

example.q: Today is Wednesday. What is the day after tomorrow? What was the day before yesterday?
steps: Tomorrow: Thursday. Day after tomorrow: Friday.
Yesterday: Tuesday. Day before yesterday: Monday.

learn.reallife: Planning a trip 'the day after tomorrow' or remembering a test 'the day before yesterday' uses these words every day!

games.title: Days the weekday moves on to the next month

quiz.q: Today is Monday. What day is the day after tomorrow?
quiz.explain: Tomorrow is Tuesday, the day after is Wednesday.
steps: Today is Monday, so tomorrow is Tuesday.
The day after tomorrow is one more day on.

quiz.q: Today is Friday. What was the day before yesterday?
quiz.explain: Yesterday was Thursday; the day before that was Wednesday.
steps: Today is Friday, so yesterday was Thursday.
The day before yesterday is one more day back.

quiz.q: 1 March is a Sunday. March has 31 days. What day is 1 April?
quiz.explain: 31 days = 4 weeks + 3 days. Sunday + 3 days = Wednesday.
quiz.mistake: Thinks the weekday stays the same

quiz.q: 1 April is a Wednesday. April has 30 days. What day is 1 May?
quiz.explain: 30 days = 4 weeks + 2 days. Wednesday + 2 = Friday.

quiz.q: In a year that is not a leap year, 1 February is a Tuesday. What day is 1 March?
quiz.explain: February has exactly 28 days = 4 weeks, so the weekday stays the same.
steps: In an ordinary year, February has 28 days.
28 days = 4 weeks exactly, so the weekday comes round again.

quiz.q: Today is the 10th. What date was the day before yesterday?
steps: Yesterday was the 9th; the day before yesterday is 2 days back.

quiz.q: Today is the 27th. What date will the day after tomorrow be?
steps: Tomorrow is the 28th; the day after tomorrow is 2 days on.

quiz.q: How many days does the weekday move on from 1 July to 1 August? (July has 31 days.)
quiz.explain: 31 days is 4 weeks and 3 days, so it moves on 3 days.
steps: So the weekday moves on 3 days.

teach.ask: Gappu knows 1 January is a Monday and wants to find the day on 1 February. Explain the trick.
teach.praise: 31 days is 4 weeks and 3 days, so Monday + 3 = Thursday!
teach.nudge: How many full weeks are in 31 days, and how many days are extra?

revise.summary: Yesterday is 1 day before today and tomorrow is 1 day after; 'the day before yesterday' and 'the day after tomorrow' are 2 days. The same date moves to a later weekday in the next month.
focus: Find the day and date before yesterday and after tomorrow
Find the weekday of the 1st of the next month
remember: A 31-day month moves the weekday 3 days on; a 30-day month 2 days; a 28-day February 0 days
1 January Monday, so 1 February is Thursday
traps: Don't count only 1 day for 'the day after tomorrow'
The weekday does not stay the same after a 31-day month
Don't count forward for 'the day before yesterday'

learn.hook: Your juice box says 'Best before 6 months from manufacture'. When does it expire?
points: To find who is older, compare birth years first, then months, then dates. The earlier date is older.
Find how much older by counting days, months or years between the birth dates.
To find a future birthday's date, keep the day and month and change the year: born 14 June 2016, 10th birthday is 14 June 2026.
A pack shows a manufacturing (MFD) date and an expiry (EXP) date. Count the months and days between them to find how long it is good for.

example.q: A biscuit packet was made on 10 March 2026. It expires on 10 September 2026. How long is it good for?
steps: From 10 March to 10 September: count months.
April, May, June, July, August, September: 6 months.

learn.reallife: Always check the expiry date on medicines and food packets before using them!

items.q: MFD Jan, EXP July (same date): months
Born 3 June and 11 June: days apart

games.title: Who is older?
items: A child born in 2015 is older than one born in 2017.
Someone born on 20 March is older than someone born on 12 March of the same year.
12 March comes first, so that person is older.
A 10th birthday of a child born 5 May 2016 is 5 May 2026.
Food should be eaten after the expiry date.
It may be unsafe after expiry.
MFD means the date the product was made.

quiz.q: Asha was born on 12 March 2016. Ravi was born on 20 March 2016. Who is older and by how many days?
quiz.explain: Same year and month; 12 comes before 20. 20 − 12 = 8 days. Asha is older.
steps: Same month and year, so compare the dates: 12 and 20.
The earlier date is older: Asha (12th) was born first.
20 − 12 = 8, so Asha is older by 8 days.
quiz.mistake: Thinks the bigger date is older

quiz.q: Rohit was born in 2014 and his sister in 2019. How many years older is Rohit?
Meena was born on 14 June 2016. On what date is her 10th birthday?
quiz.explain: Keep the date and month, add 10 to the year: 2016 + 10 = 2026.
steps: A birthday keeps the same date and month.
10th birthday: add 10 to the birth year: 2016 + 10 = 2026.

quiz.q: A juice packet: MFD 1 January, EXP 1 April (same year). How many months is it good for?
quiz.explain: January to April is 3 months.
steps: Count the months from January to April.
So it is good for 3 months.

quiz.q: A medicine: MFD 5 May, EXP 25 May. How many days is it good for?
steps: MFD 5 May, EXP 25 May: same month.

quiz.q: Bread is made on 3 August. It stays good for 5 more days after that. What is the last good date?
quiz.explain: 3 + 5 = 8 August.
steps: Made on 3 August; good for 5 more days.
So the last good date is 8 August.

quiz.q: A packet says 'MFD: March 2026. Best before 6 months from MFD.' When does it expire?
quiz.explain: 6 months after March: Apr, May, Jun, Jul, Aug, Sep. So September 2026.
steps: April (1), May (2), June (3), July (4), August (5), September (6).

quiz.q: Who is the oldest? Ali: 5 Jan 2016, Bina: 30 Dec 2015, Chetan: 1 Feb 2016.
quiz.explain: Bina was born in 2015, the earliest year.
steps: Compare years first: Bina 2015; Ali and Chetan 2016.
quiz.mistake: Looks only at the date number

teach.ask: Gappu found a cake box: MFD 10 June, EXP 10 August. Gappu wants to know how long it is good for and if it is safe on 15 August.
teach.praise: 2 months, and 15 August is after the expiry, so I will not eat it!
teach.nudge: How many months from MFD to EXP, and is 15 August before or after expiry?

revise.summary: To find who is older, compare birth years first, then months, then dates; the earlier date is older. A pack's MFD and EXP dates tell how long it is good for.
focus: Find who is older and by how much
Find the date of a future birthday
Count months or days between MFD and EXP dates
remember: Compare years, then months, then dates. The earlier date is older
Born 14 June 2016: 10th birthday is 14 June 2026
MFD 10 March 2026, EXP 10 September 2026: 6 months
traps: The bigger date number is not older
Don't count the starting month too
Look at the year first, not only the date number

learn.hook: Baisakhi, Chaitra, Muharram, Ramzan... Different communities in India use their own calendars too!
points: Besides the English calendar, communities use other calendars, like Hindu, Islamic and Sikh calendars, with their own month names and New Year.
Hindu month Chaitra usually falls around March–April. Baisakh (Vaisakh) falls around April–May; Baisakhi is in mid-April.
The Islamic calendar follows the moon. Its months, like Muharram and Ramzan, come about 10 to 11 days earlier every year in the English calendar.
Amavasya (new moon) and Purnima (full moon) repeat in a pattern: each comes about once every 29 to 30 days, about 15 days apart.
Many festivals are fixed by the moon: Diwali is on an Amavasya; Holi and Guru Nanak Jayanti are on a Purnima.

example.q: Purnima was on 5 March. About when will the next Purnima be?
steps: Purnima comes about every 29 to 30 days.
5 March + about 29 or 30 days → about 3 or 4 April.

learn.reallife: Ask your grandparents which calendar months they use for festivals. You may learn new month names!

games.title: Moon and calendars
items: Purnima comes about once a month.
Amavasya and Purnima are about 15 days apart.
The Islamic calendar's months fall on the same English dates every year.
They come about 10 to 11 days earlier each year.
Diwali is celebrated on an Amavasya.
It is on the new moon night.
Every community in India uses only the English calendar.
Many also use their own calendars.

quiz.q: What is Purnima?
quiz.explain: Purnima is the full moon night.
steps: Purnima is the full moon night.

quiz.q: What is Amavasya?
options: New moon, when we cannot see the moon
quiz.explain: On Amavasya the moon is not seen.
steps: On Amavasya the moon cannot be seen.
Purnima is the full moon, so Amavasya = new moon.
Answer: New moon, when we cannot see the moon

quiz.q: About how many days are there from one Purnima to the next?
quiz.explain: The moon's cycle takes about 29 to 30 days.
steps: The moon's cycle from one full moon to the next takes about 29 to 30 days.
So from one Purnima to the next is about 30 days.
(About 15 days is only Purnima to Amavasya.)
quiz.mistake: Gives the gap between Purnima and Amavasya

quiz.q: About how many days after Amavasya does Purnima come?
quiz.explain: They are about half a moon cycle apart: about 15 days.
steps: Purnima and Amavasya are half a moon cycle apart.
Half of about 30 days is about 15 days.

quiz.q: Around which English months does the Hindu month Chaitra usually fall?
quiz.explain: Chaitra usually begins in March and ends in April.
steps: The Hindu month Chaitra usually begins in March.

quiz.q: Why do Islamic months move to different English dates each year?
options: The Islamic calendar follows the moon
quiz.explain: A moon year is about 354 days, about 11 days shorter than 365.
steps: The Islamic calendar follows the moon.
A moon year is about 354 days, about 11 days shorter than 365.
So Islamic months move to different English dates each year.
Answer: The Islamic calendar follows the moon

quiz.q: Diwali falls on which kind of night?
quiz.explain: Diwali is on Amavasya, which is why lamps light up the dark night.
steps: Amavasya is the new moon, the darkest night.
That is why lamps light up the night.

quiz.q: A Purnima is on 10 May. About when is the next Amavasya?
quiz.explain: Amavasya comes about 15 days after Purnima: 10 + 15 = 25 May.
steps: Amavasya comes about 15 days after Purnima.

teach.ask: Gappu's grandma says the next festival is on the next Purnima. Today is Purnima. When should Gappu expect it?
teach.praise: Purnima comes about every 29 to 30 days, so the festival is about a month away!
teach.nudge: How long does the moon take to become full again?

revise.summary: Communities also use other calendars, like Hindu, Islamic and Sikh calendars, with their own months and New Year. Amavasya (new moon) and Purnima (full moon) repeat in a pattern, and many festivals are fixed by the moon.
focus: Know Purnima and Amavasya and the gaps between them
Know why Islamic months move in the English calendar
Link festivals and Hindu months to the moon and English months
remember: Purnima: full moon. Amavasya: new moon
Each comes about once every 29 to 30 days, about 15 days apart
Diwali is on an Amavasya; Holi and Guru Nanak Jayanti are on a Purnima
Chaitra usually falls around March–April
traps: Don't mix up Purnima and Amavasya
Purnima to the next Amavasya is about 15 days, not a full cycle
Not all calendars match the English calendar

topics.title: How many hours in a day?

learn.hook: You sleep, eat, study and play. Do all your activities add up to one full day?
points: A day has 24 hours.
From 6 am to 6 pm is 12 hours. From 6 am to the next morning's 6 am is 24 hours.
Add up the hours spent on each activity to see how a day is used.
If you know the hours for some activities, subtract from 24 to find the rest.

example.q: Mohan sleeps 9 hours, is at school 7 hours, plays 2 hours and studies 2 hours. How many hours are left for other things?

learn.reallife: A railway timetable runs all 24 hours, and some shops are open 24 hours a day!

games.title: Day facts
items: That is one full turn of the Earth.
From 6 am to 6 pm is 24 hours.
From 9 pm to 9 am is 12 hours.
Count: 9 pm to 9 am is 12 hours.
All the activities in a day add up to 24 hours.
Sleep, school, play and the rest fill the day.
Sleeping from 10 pm to 6 am is 6 hours.

quiz.q: How many hours are there in a day?
quiz.explain: A full day has 24 hours.
steps: One full day goes from midnight to the next midnight.
(12 hours is only half a day.)

quiz.q: How many hours from 6 am to 6 pm?
quiz.explain: 6 am to 12 noon is 6 hours, then 6 more to 6 pm: 12.

quiz.q: How many hours from 6 am today to 6 am tomorrow?
quiz.explain: That is one full day, 24 hours.
steps: 6 am today to 6 am tomorrow is one full day.

quiz.q: Pinky sleeps from 9 pm to 6 am. How many hours does she sleep?
quiz.explain: 9 pm to 12 midnight is 3 hours; 12 to 6 am is 6 hours. 3 + 6 = 9.

quiz.q: Ravi sleeps 10 hours and is at school 6 hours. How many hours are left in the day?
quiz.mistake: Gives the hours used instead of left

quiz.q: Sita's day: sleep 9 h, school 7 h, homework 2 h, play 2 h, meals 2 h. How many hours is that?
In Sita's day, how many hours are not listed?
steps: A day has 24 hours; Sita's listed hours add up to 22.

quiz.q: A shop is open from 8 am to 8 pm. How many hours is it open?
quiz.explain: 8 am to 12 noon is 4 h; 12 noon to 8 pm is 8 h. 4 + 8 = 12.

teach.ask: Gappu wonders why the day feels so short. Help Gappu add up the hours in a day.
teach.praise: Sleep, school, play and more add up to 24 hours. Now I can plan my day!
teach.nudge: How many hours does a day have, and how do you find time left?

revise.summary: A day has 24 hours. Add up the hours spent on each activity, and subtract from 24 to find the hours left.
focus: Find hours between two times, including past midnight
Add hours spent on activities
Find hours left in a day
remember: A day has 24 hours
6 am to 6 pm is 12 hours; 6 am to the next 6 am is 24 hours
9 pm to 6 am: 3 + 6 = 9 hours
traps: A day does not have 12 hours
Don't subtract 9 − 6 for 9 pm to 6 am
Don't give the hours used when the hours left are asked

topics.title: How long does it take? Time durations

learn.hook: School starts at 8:00 am and ends at 1:30 pm. How long are you in school? Let's count the time!
points: am is for times from midnight to noon (morning). pm is for times from noon to midnight (afternoon and night).
1 hour = 60 minutes. 2 hours = 120 minutes.
To find how long, count on: first to the next full hour, then the hours, then the minutes.
To find the end time, add the time taken to the start time. If minutes reach 60, change them into 1 hour.

example.q: A cricket match on TV goes from 2:40 pm to 4:10 pm. How long is it?

learn.reallife: We work out how long a train journey takes, or how long we can play before dinner.

quiz.q: School starts at 8:00 am and ends at 1:30 pm. How long is the school day?
quiz.explain: 8:00 am to 12:00 noon is 4 hours. 12:00 to 1:30 pm is 1 hour 30 minutes. Total: 5 hours 30 minutes.
quiz.mistake: Counts from 8 to 1 wrongly by forgetting that 12 comes before 1

quiz.q: How many minutes are there in 2 hours?
quiz.explain: 1 hour = 60 minutes. 2 × 60 = 120 minutes.

quiz.q: A film starts at 3:15 pm and lasts 2 hours. When does it end?
quiz.explain: Add 2 hours to 3:15 pm: 4:15 pm, then 5:15 pm. It is still afternoon, so pm.
steps: It is still afternoon, so 5:15 pm.
quiz.mistake: Changes pm to am, or adds 2 minutes

quiz.q: Arjun eats breakfast at 7 o'clock in the morning. How do we write this time?
quiz.explain: Morning times before noon use am. So it is 7:00 am.
steps: am is used for times after midnight and before noon.
7 o'clock in the morning is before noon.

quiz.q: A cricket match on TV goes from 2:40 pm to 4:10 pm. How long is it?
quiz.explain: 2:40 to 3:00 is 20 minutes, 3:00 to 4:00 is 60 minutes, 4:00 to 4:10 is 10 minutes. 20 + 60 + 10 = 90.

quiz.q: Riya sleeps at 9:30 pm and wakes up at 6:30 am. How long does she sleep?
quiz.explain: 9:30 pm to 12:00 midnight is 2 hours 30 minutes. Midnight to 6:30 am is 6 hours 30 minutes. Together: 9 hours.
quiz.mistake: Subtracts 9:30 - 6:30 and forgets the time goes past midnight

quiz.q: How many hours and minutes is 90 minutes?
quiz.explain: 60 minutes make 1 hour. 90 - 60 = 30. So 90 minutes = 1 hour 30 minutes.
quiz.mistake: Thinks 1 hour is 40 minutes or divides by 10

quiz.q: A clock shows 10:45. What time will it be 20 minutes later?
quiz.explain: 10:45 + 15 minutes = 11:00. 5 more minutes makes 11:05.

teach.ask: Gappu's train leaves at 2:40 pm and arrives at 4:10 pm. Gappu did 410 - 240 = 170 minutes. Is that right?
teach.praise: Aha! An hour has 60 minutes, not 100. Count on: 20 + 60 + 10 = 90 minutes!
teach.nudge: How many minutes are in an hour? Try counting on to 3:00 first.

revise.summary: am is for times from midnight to noon and pm from noon to midnight; 1 hour = 60 minutes. To find how long, count on to the next full hour, then the hours, then the minutes.
focus: Find how long something takes
Find the end time from a start time
Use am and pm correctly
remember: 1 hour = 60 minutes. 2 hours = 120 minutes
Count on: to the next full hour, then the hours, then the minutes
90 minutes = 1 hour 30 minutes
traps: Don't subtract times like ordinary numbers (410 − 240)
An hour is not 100 minutes
Don't write 10:65; change 60 minutes into 1 hour

learn.hook: A digital clock shows 07:45. Your school bell rings at 08:00. How many minutes to go?
points: A digital clock shows hours, then minutes: 07:45 means 7 hours and 45 minutes, which is 7:45.
Look for am or pm on the clock to know if it is morning or evening.
A schedule lists events with start and end times. Each event starts when the one before ends.
Add the time taken to a start time to find when an event ends.
Many small tasks take about 5 minutes: brushing teeth, packing a bag.

example.q: Assembly 8:00 am to 8:20 am. Period 1 lasts 40 minutes after that. When does period 1 end?

learn.reallife: Railway stations, phones and microwave ovens all show digital time. Schedules keep schools and trains on time!

quiz.q: A digital clock shows 07:45 am. What time is it?
quiz.explain: 07:45 means 7 hours 45 minutes; am means morning.
steps: So it is 7:45 in the morning.

quiz.q: A digital clock shows 09:05 pm. Which is correct?
quiz.explain: 09:05 is 9 hours 5 minutes; pm means evening or night.
steps: So it is 5 minutes past 9 at night.

quiz.q: Assembly ends at 8:20 am. Period 1 is 40 minutes long. When does it end?
quiz.explain: 8:20 + 40 minutes = 8:60, which is 9:00.

quiz.q: Lunch starts at 12:30 pm and lasts 30 minutes. Next is art for 45 minutes. When does art end?
quiz.explain: Lunch ends 1:00 pm. 1:00 + 45 minutes = 1:45 pm.

quiz.q: Which task takes about 5 minutes?
quiz.explain: Brushing teeth takes a few minutes.
steps: Brushing your teeth takes a few minutes.
A school day, a train journey and a night's sleep take hours.
So brushing your teeth takes about 5 minutes.

quiz.q: The bus comes at 7:50 am. The digital clock shows 07:38. How many minutes until the bus comes?
quiz.explain: 50 − 38 = 12 minutes.
steps: Both times are in the 7 o'clock hour.

quiz.q: Sports starts at 3:15 pm and lasts 50 minutes. When does it end?
quiz.explain: 15 + 50 = 65 minutes = 1 hour 5 minutes. 3:15 + 50 min = 4:05 pm.

quiz.q: Tying both shoes takes about 2 minutes. Packing your bag takes about 5 minutes. How long for both?
quiz.explain: 2 + 5 = 7 minutes.

teach.ask: Gappu's tuition starts at 4:40 pm and lasts 35 minutes. Gappu wants to know when it ends. Explain.
teach.praise: 40 + 35 = 75 minutes = 1 hour 15 minutes, so it ends at 5:15 pm!
teach.nudge: What happens when the minutes go past 60?

revise.summary: A digital clock shows hours, then minutes, with am or pm. A schedule lists events with start and end times; add the time taken to a start time to find the end.
focus: Read digital clock times
Find end times in a schedule
Find minutes until an event
remember: 07:45 means 7 hours and 45 minutes
Each event starts when the one before ends
Many small tasks take about 5 minutes, like brushing teeth or packing a bag
traps: Don't swap the hours and minutes
Don't write 8:60; it is 9:00
Don't forget the time of an earlier event in the schedule

learn.hook: Tick, tock! The train leaves at 7:05. Can you read the clock and not miss it?
points: The short hand shows the hour. The long hand shows the minutes.
The long hand moves from one number to the next in 5 minutes. So at 4 it shows 20 minutes, at 9 it shows 45 minutes.
Between two numbers there are 5 small marks. Each small mark is 1 minute.
Quarter past 6 is 6:15. Half past 6 is 6:30. Quarter to 7 is 6:45.
We write minutes with two digits: 7 o'clock and 5 minutes is 7:05.

example.q: The short hand is between 4 and 5. The long hand is 2 small marks after the 7. What time is it?
steps: Hour: the short hand has passed 4, so the hour is 4.

learn.reallife: We read clocks to catch the school bus, start a cricket match or know when our favourite show begins.

items.q: Long hand on 3: how many minutes past?
Long hand on 6: how many minutes past?
Long hand on 8: how many minutes past?
Long hand on 11: how many minutes past?
Long hand 3 small marks after 2: minutes past?
Long hand on 1: how many minutes past?

quiz.q: The short hand is just past 3 and the long hand is on 4. What time is it?
quiz.explain: The short hand shows 3 o'clock has passed. The long hand on 4 means 4 × 5 = 20 minutes. So it is 3:20.
steps: The short hand is just past 3, so the hour is 3.
The long hand on 4 means 4 × 5 = 20 minutes.
quiz.mistake: Reads the long hand number as the minutes (3:04) or mixes up the hands

quiz.q: The long hand points to 9. How many minutes past the hour is it?
quiz.explain: Each number on the clock is 5 minutes for the long hand. 9 × 5 = 45 minutes.
steps: Each number on the clock = 5 minutes for the long hand.

quiz.q: What time is 'quarter past 6'?
quiz.explain: A quarter of an hour is 15 minutes. Quarter past 6 is 15 minutes after 6: 6:15.
steps: A quarter of an hour = 60 ÷ 4 = 15 minutes.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up quarter past and quarter to

quiz.q: What time is 'half past 11'?
quiz.explain: Half an hour is 30 minutes. Half past 11 is 11:30.

quiz.q: The clock shows 8:50. How else can we say this time?
quiz.explain: 8:50 is 10 minutes before 9:00, so it is 10 minutes to 9.
quiz.mistake: Uses the hour that has passed instead of the coming hour

quiz.q: How many minutes are there in 1 hour?
quiz.explain: The long hand goes all the way round once in 60 minutes. That is 1 hour.
steps: The long hand goes round once in 1 hour.
quiz.mistake: Thinks an hour has 100 minutes, like a metre has 100 cm

quiz.q: The short hand is between 4 and 5. The long hand is 2 small marks after the 7. What time is it?
quiz.explain: The hour is 4. The long hand at 7 means 35 minutes, and 2 more marks make 37. So 4:37.
quiz.mistake: Writes the 7 and the 2 side by side

quiz.q: The train leaves at 7 o'clock and 5 minutes. How do we write this time?
quiz.explain: Minutes are written with two digits. 5 minutes is written as 05, so 7:05.
steps: Minutes are written with two digits.

teach.ask: Gappu sees the long hand on 4 and says it is 4 minutes past. Is Gappu right?
teach.praise: Thank you! Each number is 5 minutes for the long hand, so 4 means 20 minutes. Gappu reads clocks now!
teach.nudge: How many minutes does the long hand take to go from one number to the next?

revise.summary: The short hand shows the hour and the long hand shows the minutes. The long hand moves from one number to the next in 5 minutes, and each small mark is 1 minute.
focus: Read time to the minute
Use quarter past, half past and quarter to
Write minutes with two digits
remember: Long hand at 4: 20 minutes; at 9: 45 minutes
Quarter past 6 is 6:15. Half past 6 is 6:30. Quarter to 7 is 6:45
7 o'clock and 5 minutes is 7:05
traps: Don't read the number the long hand points to as the minutes
Don't mix up quarter past and quarter to
7:50 is not 7 o'clock and 5 minutes

learn.hook: Bunty says the clock shows 12:15, but it is really 3 o'clock. What went wrong?
points: The short hand is the hour hand. The long hand is the minute hand.
Mixing up the hands gives a wrong time: hour hand on 3 and minute hand on 12 is 3:00, not 12:15.
Read the hour from the number the short hand has just passed, not the one it is moving towards.
At 7:30 the hour hand is halfway between 7 and 8. It is still 7-something, not 8.
To read a clock: (1) find the short hand and read the hour, (2) find the long hand and count minutes in 5s, (3) add the extra small marks.

example.q: The short hand is just before 8. The long hand is on 10. What time is it?
steps: The short hand has passed 7 and not reached 8: hour = 7.

learn.reallife: Train stations and schools run on time only if everyone reads clocks correctly!

games.title: How to read a clock
items: Read the hour it has just passed

games.title: Spot the mistake
items: Short hand on 3, long hand on 12: the time is 3:00.
Short hand on 3, long hand on 12: the time is 12:15.
That mixes up the two hands.
At 7:30 the hour hand points halfway between 7 and 8.
It moves slowly between the numbers.
Short hand just before 8, long hand on 10: the time is 8:50.
The hour is still 7, so it is 7:50.
The long hand on 6 shows 30 minutes.

quiz.q: The short hand is on 3 and the long hand is on 12. What time is it?
quiz.explain: Short hand gives the hour (3); long hand on 12 means 0 minutes.
steps: The short hand gives the hour: 3.
The long hand on 12 means 0 minutes.

quiz.q: The short hand is halfway between 6 and 7 and the long hand is on 6. Bunty says it is 7:30. What is the right time?
quiz.explain: Short hand between 6 and 7 → hour 6. Long hand on 6 → 30 minutes. 6:30.
steps: The short hand between 6 and 7 means the hour is still 6.
The long hand on 6 means 6 × 5 = 30 minutes.

quiz.q: The short hand is just before 8. The long hand is on 10. What time is it?
quiz.explain: The hour hand has not reached 8, so it is still 7. 10 × 5 = 50 minutes.
steps: The short hand has not reached 8 yet, so the hour is still 7.
The long hand on 10 means 10 × 5 = 50 minutes.
quiz.mistake: Reads the hour it is moving towards

quiz.q: Which hand shows the hour?
quiz.explain: The short hand points to the hour.
steps: A clock has a short hand and a long hand.
The short hand shows the hour.
The long hand shows the minutes.

quiz.q: The long hand is on 4. How many minutes past the hour is it?
quiz.explain: 4 × 5 = 20 minutes.
steps: Each number = 5 minutes for the long hand.

quiz.q: At 9:45, where is the hour hand?
options: Most of the way from 9 to 10
quiz.explain: 45 minutes is three-quarters of an hour, so the hour hand is three-quarters of the way to 10.
steps: The hour hand moves slowly from 9 to 10 during the hour.
45 minutes is three-quarters of an hour.
So the hour hand is most of the way from 9 to 10.
Answer: Most of the way from 9 to 10
quiz.mistake: Thinks the hour hand stays on the number

quiz.q: Rina says the time is 4:12 because the short hand is on 12 and the long hand is on 4. What is the right time?
quiz.explain: Short hand on 12 → hour 12. Long hand on 4 → 20 minutes. 12:20.
steps: The short hand shows the hour: it is on 12, so the hour is 12.
The long hand on 4 means 4 × 5 = 20 minutes.
So the right time is 12:20, not 4:12.

quiz.q: The long hand is 3 small marks after the 2. How many minutes past the hour?
quiz.explain: 2 × 5 = 10, plus 3 small marks = 13 minutes.
